name: Celâl Bayar
contribution: A Turkish economist and politician who was the president of Turkey from 1950 to 1960.
legacy: This began Turkey's multiparty period, which still goes on to this day

checks.lead: Mahmut Celâlettin "Celâl" Bayar (16 May 1883 – 22 August 1986) was a Turkish economist and politician who was the president of Turkey from 1950 to 1960. He previously served as the prime minister of Turkey from 1937 to 1939.
